title: ConceptARC at Scale: Studying Conceptual Understanding in Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06732v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) perform well on challenging benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether they form generalizable abstractions across conceptually related reasoning tasks. The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) provides a controlled testbed for studying abstraction, requiring solvers to infer transformation rules over two-dimensional grids from a small set of examples. While ARC evaluates rule abstraction within individual tasks, different tasks may share higher-level structure despite requiring different transformations$\unicode{x2014}$for example, several tasks may involve reasoning about objects contained within other objects. Benchmarks such as ConceptARC capture this structure by grouping ARC-style tasks into recurring spatial and semantic concepts, but they often contain only a few manually constructed tasks per concept. We introduce ConceptARC at Scale, a generator for creating thousands of ARC-style tasks targeting

translated_title: 规模化ConceptARC：研究推理模型中的概念理解
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在具有挑战性的基准测试中表现优异，但它们能否在概念相关的推理任务之间形成可泛化的抽象仍不明确。抽象与推理语料库（ARC）为研究抽象能力提供了一个受控的测试平台，要求求解者从少量示例中推断二维网格上的变换规则。虽然ARC评估的是单个任务内的规则抽象能力，但不同任务可能共享更高层次的结构，即便它们需要不同的变换——例如，多个任务可能都涉及对“被包含在其他对象中的对象”进行推理。像ConceptARC这样的基准通过将ARC风格的任务按反复出现的空间和语义概念进行分组来捕捉这种结构，但它们通常每个概念只包含少量手工构建的任务。我们提出了ConceptARC at Scale，这是一个生成器，可以创建数千个针对特定概念的ARC风格任务。
tldr: 该论文提出ConceptARC at Scale，一个能够大规模生成数千个针对特定概念的ARC风格任务的生成器，用于系统研究大型推理模型能否在概念相关的推理任务上形成可泛化的抽象能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ConceptARC at Scale, a generator for creating thousands of ARC-style tasks targeting specific concepts, enabling systematic study of whether large reasoning models form generalizable abstractions across conceptually related reasoning tasks.
